confirmatory.confirmatory_scope: the only confirmatory result is this family's reject_at_alpha (holdout targets, H-A, Holm-adjusted); the by_target train (exploratory, pre-exposed) and fix-verification (pre-exposed, no hit-count prediction) sections are never confirmatory

contrasts.direction_note: two-sided: reject_at_alpha means the arms' T_first separated in either direction; faster_arm (more observed than expected events = earlier T_first) says which arm is faster; null when no arm is. One contrast alone gives no verdict: the D040-D12 table reads both

permutation.note: monte-carlo: 2^98 too large to enumerate; seed-fixed 100000 draws over the informative blocks; p = (ge + 1) / (N + 1)

supplementary.u_viol_a12_note: Vargha-Delaney A12 on per-seed U_viol (secondary metric; higher = more unique violations, so >0.5 favors arm_a), seed-block paired over seeds observed in both arms. SUPPLEMENTARY effect size (research-questions v2 U_viol: Mann-Whitney/A12), NOT a confirmatory test (EN-008).
